sections.title: Overview
descriptions: Officer Hope N. Groesbeck was employed by the American Fork Police Department from February 25, 2019, through June 26, 2024. She resigned before the department completed an internal affairs investigation into her sexual relationship with fellow Officer Jacob W. Hager, which included sexual activity while they were on duty.
This profile includes employment data and records from the Utah POST disciplinary proceedings, in which the POST Council suspended her peace officer certification for three and a half years.

sections.title: Background
descriptions: This section provides limited background information for identity verification and accurate record matching.

Officer Hope N. Groesbeck (maiden name Hope N. Carter) was born on November 25, 1989. She is from Lehi, Utah, and graduated from Lehi High School in 2008. She has also publicly used the name Hope Carter Groesbeck and is married to Ty Groesbeck.

sections.title: POST Discipline
descriptions: According to the POST disciplinary proceedings, Hope N. Groesbeck had sexual intercourse with Officer Jacob W. Hager while on duty, in department vehicles in public locations. Both officers estimated that this occurred between 40 and 50 times during their sexual relationship, which lasted from October 2023 through June 2024.

Groesbeck resigned on June 26, 2024, before the investigation concluded. She did not attend the subsequent disciplinary hearing but was represented by counsel. The POST Council voted to suspend her peace officer certification for three and a half years.
